definitions.explanation: The angular distance of a place north or south of the earth's equator, measured in degrees. Used in geography and navigation.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}の{緯度|いど}は{北緯|ほくい}35{度|ど}{付近|ふきん}だ。
examples.english: Tokyo's latitude is around 35 degrees north.

examples.japanese: {緯度|いど}が{高|たか}いほど{寒|さむ}くなる。
examples.english: The higher the latitude, the colder it gets.

examples.japanese: {緯度|いど}と{経度|けいど}で{位置|いち}を{特定|とくてい}する。
examples.english: To specify a location using latitude and longitude.

notes:
{緯度|いど} is a geography term for latitude — the angular distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {北緯|ほくい}: north latitude
- {南緯|なんい}: south latitude
- {緯度|いど}が{高|たか}い: high latitude (closer to poles)
- {緯度|いど}が{低|ひく}い: low latitude (closer to equator)
- {緯度|いど}と{経度|けいど}: latitude and longitude

WORD FORMATION:
{緯|い} (weft, latitude) + {度|ど} (degree). The character {緯|い} originally refers to horizontal threads in weaving, extended to mean the east-west lines on a globe.

CONTRAST:
- {緯度|いど}: latitude (north-south position)
- {経度|けいど}: longitude (east-west position)

HOMOPHONE:
{井戸|いど} (well) has the same reading but completely different meaning and kanji.
